cues.text: In the widening arc of a moment,
Where the past and the future meet,
There’s a place where the edges soften,
And the ground hums under our feet.
Every choice is a line in the lattice,
Every step is a shimmer revealed—
We are walking a path between worlds,
In the unified field.
Oh, dance with the light of a thousand suns,
In this tapestry where the journey runs,
Together we rise, together we feel,
Every heartbeat echoes in the unified field.
There are blooms in the heart of becoming,
Petals opening one by one,
All the stories we carry inside us,
All the light we’ve borrowed from the sun.
We are layered with quiet awakenings,
Every wound that has slowly healed—
There’s a tenderness shaping our growing,
In the unified field.
Oh, dance with the light of a thousand suns,
In this tapestry where the journey runs,
Together we rise, together we feel,
Every heartbeat echoes in the unified field.
Oh, we rise in relation,
We grow where we are held—
Every voice, every breath,
Is a part of what compels.
We are shaped by the circle around us,
And the worlds we gently yield—
Everything changes together,
In the unified field.
There are rings at the core of our stories,
Echoes older than we know,
Spirals tracing our truth in motion,
Moving inward as we grow.
In the mirror of each connection,
We remember what’s concealed—
Who we are is a dance with the cosmos,
In the unified field.
Oh, dance with the light of a thousand suns,
In this tapestry where the journey runs,
Together we rise, together we feel,
Every heartbeat echoes in the unified field.
So take my hand on this path we tread,
Nature whispers softly where the past has bled,
In the harmony of life's grand reveal,
We find our strength in the unified field.
